{
  "name": "spinner-packs",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Themed spinner words: Claude is 'Plundering…' then 'Plundered for 1m 3s'. Ten packs (pirate, Shakespeare, corporate, wizard, chef, space, noir, Gen Z, zen, retro) or your own words.",
  "author": {
    "name": "awesome-claude-mods",
    "url": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods/tree/main/mods/fun/spinner-packs",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "fun",
    "spinner",
    "theme"
  ],
  "userConfig": {
    "pack": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Word pack",
      "description": "Which words the spinner uses. random picks a pack each session; off keeps Claude Code's own.",
      "default": "random",
      "options": [
        "random",
        "pirate",
        "shakespeare",
        "corporate",
        "wizard",
        "chef",
        "space",
        "noir",
        "genz",
        "zen",
        "retro",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "custom": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Custom words",
      "description": "Comma-separated words that replace every pack, e.g. 'Frobbing|Frobbed, Yak shaving|Shaved yaks'. The part after | themes the line that closes a turn.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "themeClosingLine": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Theme the closing line",
      "description": "Also theme the line that closes a turn ('Plundered for 1m 3s'). Terminal only.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
